_note: Job A batch 4. Past-due claims due 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31. Two corpus checks: drill baby drill (earliest corpus use 10 November 2024, after Trump had campaigned on the phrase) and the channel's own concurrent viewer figure against the million-prayer-army goal.

evidence.summary: Martial law was not declared in any American city in 2025 or 2026. National Guard deployments took place in Washington DC from August 2025 and in Memphis, Portland and Chicago later in 2025, all under Title 32 or state authority and all subject to litigation; none suspended civil government or confined residents.
evidence.rationale: Martial law is a specific legal condition and it did not occur. The claim's structure is worth recording because it explains why it never resolves: he dates the vision to April 2024 and revives it whenever unrest looks close, then prays that it not come to pass, so an absence is a prayer answered and a presence would be the word fulfilled. National Guard on city streets is a real 2025 development and is not the thing he described.

evidence.summary: Zohran Mamdani won the New York City mayoral election on 4 November 2025 with 50.78 percent, defeating Andrew Cuomo and Curtis Sliwa, on the highest turnout since 1969. The race did not flip. No uprising, rioting or pillaging followed in New York.
evidence.rationale: Both halves failed. The race went to the candidate he was praying against, by a clear margin, and the rioting and pillaging he says he saw for New York did not materialise then or since. He gave himself an out in advance by making the outcome depend on people pushing in during the midnight hour, which is the prayer-conditional structure the schema records as a field; it is noted, not accepted as an excuse.

evidence.summary: SNAP funding lapsed on 1 November 2025 for the first time in the programme's sixty-year history, affecting about 42 million people. Federal courts in Massachusetts and Rhode Island ordered partial payment on 31 October; USDA then ordered states to stop issuing full benefits and to undo November payments already sent. Several states advanced their own money to bridge the gap. The shutdown ended on 12 November 2025.
evidence.rationale: He named the mechanism and roughly the deadline on 27 October: no budget by the following Saturday and funding stops. Funding did stop, for the largest federal food programme, within days of the date he gave. What is wrong is the direction and the number. He said at least twenty-five states would cut off funding; what happened is that federal funding lapsed and a number of states moved the opposite way, spending their own money to keep benefits flowing. He also spoke a week into a shutdown whose SNAP deadline USDA had already announced publicly on 24 October.

evidence.summary: US Black Friday 2025 set record online spending. Equities fell in mid-November on artificial-intelligence valuation concerns and recovered by early December; there was no crash on or around Black Friday. The month's real decline was in crypto, where bitcoin fell to 80,255 dollars on 21 November, down 36 percent from its 6 October record.
evidence.rationale: The only checkable content is a market or retail event around November later judged illusory, or a crash on a Black Friday, and neither occurred. What you see is fake carries no criterion on its own; applied to any market at any time it is unfalsifiable, and it is doing all the work in this claim. The crypto drawdown is the nearest real November event and he does not name it here.

evidence.summary: The 2025 US corn harvest was a record, with production estimated around 16.7 billion bushels on record acreage and yields, and the harvest was effectively complete by mid-November. No notable corn event, shortage or disruption occurred in November 2025.
evidence.rationale: He offers the image without a reading and says so: it may not make much sense. The extractor marked the straw-legged figure unfalsifiable on the same grounds. An uninterpreted picture cannot fail, and supplying an interpretation now, after the fact, is exactly the hindsight the falsifier fields exist to block. Recorded with the harvest data so a later reader can see that nothing unusual happened to corn either.

evidence.summary: Crypto went the other way in the autumn of 2025. Bitcoin reached a record 126,250 dollars on 6 October, then on 10 October about 19 billion dollars of leverage was liquidated in a day, and by 21 November bitcoin had fallen 36 percent to 80,255 dollars, erasing more than a trillion dollars of market value in the worst month since 2022.
evidence.rationale: The claim is a waterfall in the fall once settlements unkink the hose, made on 19 July in a crypto context. The autumn delivered the largest liquidation event in the market's history and its worst month in three years. Directionally the opposite of what was said, on the timing that was said. The word waterfall could be read as a fall rather than a flow, but he gives it as release and increase, and a claim only means what it meant before the outcome.

evidence.summary: No aviation security incident occurred over the United States Thanksgiving travel period in 2025, which set records for passengers screened. The most serious US incident that week was the shooting of two National Guard members near the White House on 26 November 2025, unrelated to aviation.
evidence.rationale: A named holiday, a named sector and a named vulnerability, and nothing happened in it. The understaffing premise was real and widely reported during the shutdown, which makes the warning plausible rather than prophetic; plausibility is not the test. The White House shooting the day before Thanksgiving is the nearest violent event and has nothing to do with bag screening.

evidence.summary: No uprising is identifiable on or near 6 December 2025 in any named region; the claim names none. The telling is dated 23 December 2025 and is a recollection in which he and his son work out the date from their own record.
evidence.rationale: The claim has no region, no country and no description beyond a man in a black and white checkered hat, and it is asserted seventeen days after the date it fixes. There is nothing here that could have come out either way. Recorded as unfalsifiable and flagged as a retrospective dating exercise rather than a forward claim.

evidence.summary: Christmas Eve midnight mass at St Peter's was celebrated by Leo XIV on 24 December 2025 without incident. No incident occurred at any Christmas mass or in Salt Lake City, Utah, on Christmas Eve 2025.
evidence.rationale: Scored as a miss rather than as an unfalsifiable protection prayer because of the Salt Lake City detail. Naming a specific American city that has no obvious connection to a papal mass, and confirming aloud that it is in Utah, is a concrete and checkable pointer, and it produced nothing. The rest is the standard hedge over an event that has been peaceful every year.

evidence.summary: 2025 brought a rapid sequence of frontier model releases including OpenAI's GPT-5 in August 2025 and Google's Gemini 3 in November 2025, together with large increases in reported capability benchmarks and in AI capital spending, which was a principal driver of US equity returns for the year.
evidence.rationale: Technology that had been held back being released, visible at Google and the other big companies, describes 2025 accurately, and he named Google. The base rate takes most of it: he said this on 30 May 2025, more than two years into a release cycle in which every major lab had shipped a flagship model every year, and a further step change was the consensus expectation of every industry forecast at the time. Caged in a box is imagery over a public roadmap.

evidence.summary: The United States remained the world's largest economy by nominal GDP through 2025, at roughly 30 trillion dollars against China's roughly 19 trillion, and its share of global market capitalisation rose over the period. US real GDP grew in 2023, 2024 and 2025 with no recession dated.
evidence.rationale: A checkable ranking, stated in December 2023 to be already over, and the ranking did not change; on the equity measure the American lead widened. Reduced to keeping afloat is not a description of an economy that grew every year of the window and returned about 25 percent and then about 18 percent in its stock market. The oil element he attached to it is scored under oil-200-barrel, which also failed.

evidence.summary: 2025 included a twelve-day Israel-Iran war in June with US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites, a four-day India-Pakistan exchange in May, continuing war in Ukraine, and a Gaza ceasefire agreed in October 2025. It was not a year of general or expanding war; the two largest new conflicts both ended within a fortnight.
evidence.rationale: War war overstates 2025 but does not miss it entirely: two state-on-state exchanges opened and closed inside the year, one of them involving direct American strikes on Iran. Against him, the year's largest single movement was toward a ceasefire in Gaza, and Ukraine neither ended nor widened. The 2026 telling adds Poland and a horizon out to 2030, which is a new and later window and is not scored here.

evidence.summary: No revival across Asian countries was reported in 2025. Pew's global religious landscape work shows Christianity's share of the world population roughly flat over the last measured decade, with growth concentrated in sub-Saharan Africa rather than Asia.
evidence.rationale: A major revival across a continent is the kind of thing that would be reported, so this is scoreable rather than merely unfalsifiable, and nothing was reported. The channel did add language channels, which is the part within his own control and is not the claim. Praying in what sounded to him like an Asian tongue is an experience, not evidence, and is recorded as such.

evidence.summary: The Palisades and Eaton fires began on 7 January 2025 and burned through late January, destroying more than 16,000 structures in the Los Angeles area and killing 31 people, among the most destructive wildfire events in California history. No further major American city burned during the remainder of 2025.
evidence.rationale: The timing is the whole question and it goes against him. The 12 January telling, which is the one that says people will see their cities burn, was given five days after the Los Angeles fires started and while they were still burning, so it is commentary on the news. The 2 January telling predates the fires but names Las Vegas and offers a general doctrine about open doors rather than a prediction. The extractor flagged that telling at the time as an explanation offered after the fact, and the rest of 2025 brought no further city burning.

evidence.summary: No dam, wall or comparable structure or event of the kind described occurred near Ireland in 2025. On 15 December 2024 he stated in advance that the 2025 dam had been pushed back by prayer and would still be seen eventually.
evidence.rationale: The extractor's note is the finding: the date is retired in advance and the event kept. Once the claim says the thing was postponed by prayer but is still coming, no observation in 2025 or any later year can refute it. This is the clearest example in the database of the structure that makes a dated claim permanently alive, and it is recorded so that the pattern is countable rather than argued.

evidence.summary: Aggregate US household debt rose through 2025 to about 18.6 trillion dollars, with mortgage balances increasing, so no population-level debt cancellation occurred. The claim is addressed to individual viewers and no individual outcome is recorded.
evidence.rationale: It carries an unusually hard deadline for this material, nine weeks and the house paid in full, which is why the extractor flagged it as specific. It is still unfalsifiable, because the audience is unnamed and the faith clause, God is as big as your faith allows, assigns any individual failure to the hearer. The aggregate data is recorded so the claim is not left looking untested.

evidence.summary: December 2025 brought a marked escalation of US decisions on Venezuela, including authorisation of covert CIA operations, a blockade of sanctioned Venezuelan oil tankers, a CIA strike on a port facility and continued strikes on alleged drug boats, leading to the capture of Nicolas Maduro in early January 2026. The administration also released a 2025 National Security Strategy deprioritising Europe in favour of the Western Hemisphere.
evidence.rationale: Said on 31 August, three months ahead, and December did carry decisions of the weight described, taken by the president he names in the later telling. What holds it at partial is that it names no decision, no subject and no direction: major decisions will be made in December is satisfied by any active month of any presidency, and December is when budget, defence-strategy and year-end decisions cluster every year. Make or break for the United States is also not what the Venezuela decisions were; they were consequential for Venezuela.

evidence.summary: No depression-scale contraction occurred. The NBER dated no US recession in 2024 or 2025; unemployment stayed near historic lows, banks did not fail at scale after the 2023 regional episode, and equities returned about 25 percent in 2024 and about 18 percent in 2025.
evidence.rationale: The image of calendars flipping back to the 1930s sets a bar high enough to be checkable, and nothing came near it. The 2026 telling drops the claim entirely and substitutes an arithmetic aside about the national debt, which the extractor flagged unfalsifiable on the spot. The pattern to record is a dated collapse claim being replaced by commentary rather than scored.

evidence.summary: Drill, baby, drill originated as a Republican convention chant in 2008 and was a standing Trump campaign line through 2024, used at the Republican National Convention in July 2024 and in the 20 January 2025 inaugural address. Within this corpus the earliest use of the phrase is 10 November 2024, five days after the election and four months after Trump used it at the convention.
evidence.rationale: The claim is specifically that the phrase was a word he gave before Trump said it, and the corpus refutes it. Every occurrence in the archive postdates Trump's own repeated public use, and the phrase itself is sixteen years older than the channel. This is the most direct kind of finding the database can produce: a priority claim checked against the archive that is supposed to contain it, and not found.

evidence.summary: No measurable transfer of finances into churches occurred ahead of 2025; US religious giving continued to track inflation and to decline as a share of total giving. No documented wave of salvations is recorded for 2025.
evidence.rationale: The extractor flagged the first telling unfalsifiable when it was written: private financial return with no external criterion. The ordering claim, money before souls, has no threshold on either side, so neither the presence nor the absence of a harvest could settle it. Recorded with the aggregate data rather than treated as a miss.

evidence.summary: No financial crisis occurred in 2025. The S&P 500 fell about 19 percent between February and 8 April on the tariff announcement and then rose about 39 percent from that low through year end, finishing up 17.9 percent, with three Federal Reserve rate cuts and no bank failures at scale.
evidence.rationale: The stated outcome held: he declared in October 2024 that there would be no financial crisis going into 2025, and there was none. Two things cap it. No crisis in a given year is the base case, occurring in roughly four years out of five. And it sits in flat contradiction with dark-year-2025 and house-of-cards, given in the same weeks, which say the opposite; a source holding both positions at once cannot be scored for whichever one lands. That contradiction is the finding here, more than the verdict.

evidence.summary: First-freeze dates across the United States in autumn 2025 fell in their normal ranges, from September in the northern plains to December on the Gulf coast. No major event coincided with any of them, and no transfer of wealth is measurable across the period.
evidence.rationale: He removes his own marker in the telling: the Lord distinguished it as not their first frost, and he then asks each viewer when their first freeze is. With the date floating across three months by geography and the event unnamed, nothing could fail. Recorded as unfalsifiable rather than expired for that reason.

evidence.summary: The FBI stated that it disrupted four terrorist plots in December 2025. On 12 December four members of the Turtle Island Liberation Front were arrested in Lucerne Valley, California, accused of preparing coordinated New Year's Eve bombings against five Los Angeles-area targets; a fifth arrest followed in New Orleans. Further arrests were announced later in the month.
evidence.rationale: The underlying facts are real and the FBI said so publicly, which is more than most items in this queue can offer. But this is not a prediction at all: the telling is dated 12 May 2026 and consists of him reading the FBI's own announcement aloud and offering it as what the December prayers accomplished. The arrest dates he gives, the 21st and the 29th, do not match the principal case, which was the 12th. Scored partial for the accuracy of the underlying report and no higher, because the causal claim attached to it has no test.

evidence.summary: No financial crisis occurred at the start of 2025; the Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index remained in accommodative territory through the first quarter. Trump was inaugurated on 20 January 2025.
evidence.rationale: The only checkable half, no financial crisis at the start of 2025, held, and it holds for the same low-information reason as financial-storm-averted-prayer: quiet is the base case. Whether a godly person occupies the White House has no observable criterion and is not scored. The whole thing is a prayer rather than a forecast, which the record should show plainly.

evidence.summary: US household net worth reached record levels through 2025 on equity and house price gains, with the increase heavily concentrated in the top decile of holders. No supernatural transfer of wealth is identifiable, and no single great financial digital platform emerged; the GENIUS Act of July 2025 created a federal framework for payment stablecoins.
evidence.rationale: Best year and golden window have no threshold, and a supernatural wealth transfer over an unnamed audience cannot be counted. The one element with a referent, a great financial digital platform, is arguable in the stablecoin framework and is scored under new-way-of-banking rather than twice here. The foundation of the beginning of the end is not a claim about 2025 at all.

evidence.summary: Nothing corresponding to a great dam or a massive thick slate wall occurred in 2025, and the Hoover Dam itself was unaffected. The image is given without interpretation in the same passage as the presidential-candidate warning.
evidence.rationale: An uninterpreted image with a year attached and no stated meaning. The extractor's falsifier for this row was copied from the candidate warning it sits beside, which is an extraction error worth noting, not a test of this claim. Scored unfalsifiable on its own terms; the candidate warning is scored separately and strongly under candidate-outdoor-attack.

evidence.summary: No cascading financial collapse occurred. Jerome Powell remained Federal Reserve chair through 2025, the Federal Reserve cut rates three times during the year, and US equities finished 2025 up about 18 percent after a full recovery from the April drawdown.
evidence.rationale: Given twice in the days around the 2024 election with the specific condition that Powell would still be running things, which held, while the collapse did not. He hedges it in the same breath, saying he does not know the timing and praying it is not in 2025, which is honest and also means the claim carries no date of its own. Scored expired against the one window he did name.

evidence.summary: No significant event on land near Ireland occurred during 2025 of the kind described, and no barrier, blockade or dam-like structure appeared in the North Atlantic near Ireland.
evidence.rationale: A named place and a named year, which makes it scoreable, and the year passed with nothing. Something by land is thin, but Ireland is specific enough that a notable event there would have been findable. Recorded as a miss rather than as unfalsifiable because the location was given.

evidence.summary: The stated goal was a million people praying daily with the channel by 2025. His own on-air figure on 28 October 2025 was about five thousand five hundred people praying with them, roughly half a percent of the target.
evidence.rationale: The rare case where he supplies the measurement himself. A goal of one million daily, checked against his own concurrent count of about 5,500, is short by more than two orders of magnitude. Recorded as contradicted rather than expired because the number is stated on camera and needs no external source. It is also the honest thing about the telling: he says the figure out loud rather than rounding it up.

evidence.summary: No unprecedented or documented run of miracles is recorded for 2025 by any body that assesses such claims; the Lourdes Medical Bureau, the longest-running formal process of its kind, recognised none in the period.
evidence.rationale: A measure no one has ever seen has no measure. The word is also read aloud from another source rather than given by him, which under the corpus rule makes it a weaker thing than his own claim. Nothing here could have come out either way.

evidence.summary: No specific individuals are named in the claim, and no set of previously unknown ministry figures rose to broad prominence in 2025 in a way that could be matched to it.
evidence.rationale: Faces coming seemingly out of nowhere names nobody, and new prominent figures appear in every year of every movement, so any outcome confirms it. The August telling attaches a revival to a particular church and then does not identify the church, which removes the one detail that could have been checked.

evidence.summary: The GENIUS Act, signed 18 July 2025, created the first federal regulatory framework for payment stablecoins in the United States, setting licensing, reserve and Bank Secrecy Act requirements for issuers and requiring implementing regulations within a year.
evidence.rationale: A genuinely new banking framework was enacted in the year he named, and he said it in March, four months ahead. What the base rate takes back is substantial: stablecoin legislation was already moving through Congress when he spoke, the Senate having advanced the bill in March 2025, and it was among the most reported financial-policy stories of the first quarter. A new way of banking is also broad enough that several 2025 developments would have satisfied it.

evidence.summary: No population-level change corresponds to a year of turnaround for the audience. US labour market conditions softened modestly through 2025 while equity and house prices rose.
evidence.rationale: The extractor flagged both tellings before the fact, and the second flag is the important one: this is the same year-word applied to 2025 that was applied to 2024, and it will be applied again. A yearly declaration of soaring and turnaround, addressed to an unnamed audience, has no threshold in any year.

evidence.summary: Scored against this database's own record. Of the claims first due in 2025 that now carry a verdict, 31 are unfalsifiable, 12 partial matches, 9 expired without a match and 5 contradicted, with no strong matches. Across all scored claims to date there is one strong match, from December 2023.
evidence.rationale: He set the test himself in December 2024: accuracy in the prophetic would be one of the things shown in 2025, because accuracy builds trust. The tally is available now and it does not show that. More than half of the 2025 claims that could be reached had no criterion capable of failing, and among those that did, misses outnumber partial matches and nothing reached a strong match. The 2025 and 2026 tellings then shift the ground from accuracy to locating old recordings in the archive, which is a different and easier claim.

evidence.summary: US household net worth rose over the fourth quarter of 2025 on equity gains, with the gain concentrated in the highest-wealth decile, while crypto fell sharply from October. No transfer of wealth from any identified group to any identified group occurred.
evidence.rationale: The extractor flagged the October telling as private provision over an unnamed audience, which is right for both. The wealth of the wicked laid up for the righteous names no counterparty and no amount; a rising market confirms it and a falling one is a delay. Recorded so it stops sitting unchecked.

evidence.summary: 2025 saw the largest release of previously withheld federal records in years: about 80,000 pages of JFK, RFK and MLK assassination records published on 18 March, the Gabbard declassifications in July, and the Epstein Files Transparency Act signed on 19 November followed by Justice Department publication of nearly 3.5 million pages, more than 2,000 videos and 180,000 images by late December 2025.
evidence.rationale: This is the strongest of the year-named claims in the batch. Said on 9 September 2023, two years and three months ahead: everything held back is released in 2025, seen as a sludge of filth. A mass release of suppressed material did happen in 2025, and the Epstein material in particular fits the description he gave. Held at partial rather than strong for two reasons. Disclosure fights run continuously in American politics, so a release in any given year is close to the base case, and 2025 was the first year of an administration that had campaigned explicitly on releasing the JFK and Epstein files. And the second half of the same telling, that 2026 would be a severe year, is not yet scoreable.

evidence.summary: The declaration calls for double return of what was stolen in 2024, addressed to viewers generally. No individual or aggregate outcome is recorded.
evidence.rationale: Flagged unfalsifiable at extraction and it stands: private restitution over an unnamed audience, with no amount, no claimant and no deadline that anyone but the hearer could check.

evidence.summary: US real GDP contracted at an annual rate of 0.5 percent in the first quarter of 2025, the quarter beginning three weeks before the 20 January inauguration, worse than the 0.2 percent contraction economists had expected. The S&P 500 peaked on 19 February and fell about 19 percent by 8 April before recovering later in the year.
evidence.rationale: The claim was that the economy takes off like a rocket after 20 January. The first full quarter after the inauguration was the only contracting quarter of the period, and the equity market's largest drawdown of the year began a month after the date. The year ended well, but the claim was tied to the inauguration and the months immediately following, and those went the other way.
